title: Join A+B+C into an unapproved, non-authoritative production candidate-direction policy separate from eval

join_inputs.A: PP3/BP4 point contributions use eval.predictor_aggregation corrected strengths, not BIAS emitted
join_inputs.B: BS2 excluded from criterion_strength_points (deferred, decision_dependency bs2-policy)
join_inputs.C: gene/transcript scope TSC1/TSC2 MANE .5 via SPDI reconciliation; NTHL1 / base-mismatch excluded upstream

invariants.unapproved_null: approval_status stays 'unapproved' -> compute_candidate_direction returns null / production_policy_unapproved / ReviewState.POLICY_BLOCKED for every variant; non-authoritative; no external worklist released
invariants.separation_from_eval: packet.direction imports no raptor.eval.combine and does not reuse eval Tavtigian cutoffs; candidate points/thresholds independently pinned; strict 8-key schema preserved (PRD-04 slot-3 fm6)

tester.responsibility: Author AC tests (AC-D1..AC-D7) from slot 2 + slot-1 surfaces only. Derive candidate_set from config (not a magic list); assert unapproved-null, no eval.combine import, BS2/NTHL1/forbidden excluded, corrected PP3/BP4 strengths.

doer.responsibility: Pin candidate_direction.yaml (stays unapproved) + harden packet/config.py validator, in sequence parity-probe -> policy-pin -> separation-guard. May add tests, never weaken; honor slot 3.

checker.responsibility: Re-verify all ACs; confirm approval_status unchanged, null for every variant, no eval.combine import, corrected strengths used, BS2/NTHL1/forbidden excluded, no clinical classification, no worklist release, no fixture patch.

preservation_set: src/raptor/eval/combine.py (eval combiner never becomes production oracle)
blockers: Hard dependency: A, B, and C must all land first; D cannot be pinned before their outputs exist.
External worklist release remains gated on the PRD-06 held-out gate PASS + ADR-0009 policy correction + per-variant expert sign-off (out of scope here).
Approval (approval_status=approved) requires a named Oracle/expert sign-off that does not yet exist (GP-3 open); the policy stays unapproved by design.
